alt: La Mar consulta un tiquet amb una dependenta de la papereria.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one single landscape 3:2 illustration, ideally 1536×1024, for a Catalan listening-comprehension worksheet and catalogue card, printed around 80 mm wide. Reference images specify only canonical character appearance and established drawing style. Fine naturalistic ink and softly textured muted watercolor, warm paper fading into a generous pure-white border on all four edges; no frame. Warm gentle light, restrained earthy colors. Single coherent specific scene, large readable figures and natural hands, no panels, no labels, writing, numerals, logos or watermark. Keep all reference character faces, ages and clothing consistent; do not include the lettering or layout of the model sheets. Canonical Mar: adult woman with brown hair tied back, olive-green blazer over cream shirt, brown eyes. At a neighborhood stationery-shop counter she calmly shows a receipt to an occasional female assistant with an auburn bob and navy blouse. The receipt is angled away from the viewer so only its blank back can be seen. Their faces and gestures communicate an attentive practical conversation. A closed opaque shopping bag stands off to the side, contents fully hidden. The assistant is only listening, not processing the correction yet. Background stationery shelves softly suggested. No readable text or numbers, visible pen packs, money, card terminal, refund, stapler, joining papers, final receipt or result. The assistant must not copy another recurring character.
encoding: WebP quality 90; original composition and dimensions retained.
